cancelCopies.open: Cancelled here. Any open wallet request may still finish; its late reply cannot submit.

dismissalCopy.disclosure: Dismiss clears the pending record in this browser. Save the transaction ID for later checks. The transaction may already have confirmed, or it may confirm later after a rollback. A new delegation requires your approval and may incur another fee and a registration deposit.
dismissalCopy.spentElsewhere: One of its inputs was spent by a different transaction, so it can no longer be included on the chain as observed.
dismissalCopy.attestationLabel: Type "I checked this ID" to confirm that you checked this exact transaction ID in your wallet or a chain explorer.
dismissalCopy.priorNotice: A prior operation is unresolved in this browser. Keep its ID. This page can check its status and, after it expires, let you dismiss it once you have checked the ID yourself. Only the tab that signed it can send the same transaction again, until that tab reloads or its wallet disconnects or changes.

retryCopy.offer: Send the same signed transaction again
retryCopy.note: This sends the exact transaction you already approved, with the same ID, once more. Your wallet is not asked to sign again and nothing new is built.
retryCopy.checking: Checking this transaction's status and fresh account, input and pool information before sending it again.
retryCopy.sending: Sending the same signed transaction again. Submission does not mean confirmation.
retryCopy.easy1: This account now delegates to EASY1, but this transaction was not confirmed when checked. Nothing was sent again. Keep the ID and check its status, or check it in your wallet or a chain explorer.
retryCopy.expired: Too little validity remains to send this signed transaction again. Nothing was sent again. Keep the ID and check its status, or check it in your wallet or a chain explorer.
retryCopy.stopped: The signed transaction was not sent again: a check failed or information changed. Keep the ID and check its status, or check it in your wallet or a chain explorer.
retryCopy.unresolved: This transaction's status is not settled, so it was not sent again. Check its status again later, or check it in your wallet or a chain explorer.

submitCopy.reported: Blockfrost reported a validation error for this transaction. That does not prove it was not sent or included. Keep the ID and check its status here; once it expires and the check allows it, you can choose to dismiss it.
